notes: Morrow County Chamber lists TS Sales LLC/Top Shot Ammunition as a Mount Gilead business opened in 2014; no employee count found, and JobsOhio metrics show 1 job retained on a Revitalization Loan. Independent, no parent found.

Business Journal Daily (2022) says E1 Digital Direct is an affiliate of Columbiana-based Envelope 1, part of the privately owned Pidgeon Group, and the combined project retains 200 jobs. The Pidgeon Group's total headcount across all its companies was not found.

Form 5500 participants were 406 (2019) and 425 (2023), and the company site says it employs 430+ worldwide; venture-backed and privately held, headquartered in San Mateo, CA. JobsOhio metrics show 83 jobs retained at the Cleveland office.

Curation Foods was a reportable segment of Nasdaq-listed Landec (Santa Maria, CA), which reported 905 full-time employees at May 30, 2021 and 689 at May 29, 2022. Landec later sold the Curation Foods businesses and renamed itself Lifecore Biomedical (Chaska, MN).

The company's own 401(k) plan (Form 5500, 6001 Towpath Drive, Valley View, OH, NAICS 453990) reports 190 participants with 147 active in 2019 and 194 with 168 active in 2023, so it is likely 100-499 employees. No news, website or trade name was found to confirm the line of business or any parent; the JobsOhio grant was reversed (-$100,000 in FY2021, +$100,000 in FY2022).

INEOS Pigments USA (the Ashtabula titanium dioxide plants bought from Tronox/Cristal in 2019) is part of INEOS Enterprises, a unit of privately held INEOS Group, London, which had about 26,000 employees in 2021 per Wikipedia (23,000 on ineos.com today). JobsOhio metrics show 450 jobs retained in Ashtabula.

Youngstown roll-form maker founded in 1925 with more than 200 employees across three plants (Youngstown, Painesville, Kokomo IN) per Business Journal Daily 2024; it was independent in 2019 and acquired by Dallas PE firm Crossplane Capital in late 2023. The only 990 entry is a -$50,000 reversal in FY2019.
